# Förvaltaren: Vi har stängt risken mot minnesbolagen

**Feed**: dagen-med-di  
**Published**: 2026-10-05  
**Market Sentiment**: Mixed

⏱️ **Time Horizon Key**: ST = <3 months | MT = 3-12 months | LT = >12 months

---

## Episode Thesis

The episode features a fund manager (John) on global equities, focused on AI and tech. Tech has driven most of this year's MSCI World gains and is expected to deliver over half of next year's earnings growth, so 2027 is framed as a 'year of delivery' in which AI spending has to turn into profit. Energy supply, data-centre permitting and the cyclicality of memory are the key risks. The fund has closed its exposure to volatile memory makers such as Micron. It prefers 'picks and shovels' (Nvidia, TSMC, ASML), recently added an optics company, has dipped into beaten-down software and some industrials, and avoids the consumer sector.

---

## Universe Stocks

### ⛔ MU — Micron | **AVOID** (Moderate)

**Sentiment**: Negative | **Time Horizon**: MT  
**Confidence**: 70%

The fund has closed its risk in memory makers. It does not believe the doubled margins (40% to 80%) are sustainable in a cyclical industry where new capacity is coming.

#### Reasoning

The guest calls Micron a fine company with strong market positions, but memory is cyclical. Margins are far above the historical 30-40%, and new capacity, including CXMT, is arriving. If AI investment growth slows, supply catches up with demand and margins come under pressure. The low P/E reflects the market's doubts about sustainability. The fund has closed its exposure, though Micron itself says shortages will worsen in 2027-28.

#### Sell Triggers

- if memory supply tightness persists through 2027-28 as Micron guides
- if AI capex growth re-accelerates beyond expectations

> *"mot de här minnesbolagen som är de mest volatila och de som det är störst osäkerhet kring där har vi helt enkelt stängt risken"*

---

### 🟢 NVDA — Nvidia | **BUY** (Moderate)

**Sentiment**: Positive | **Time Horizon**: LT  
**Confidence**: 65%

Preferred 'picks and shovels' holding with low relative valuation and broader exposure than memory makers.

#### Reasoning

The fund chose to own more picks-and-shovels names. Nvidia's valuation is low relative to many other companies, and the market does not price in sustained growth. Its exposure is broader than the memory makers', which makes it more resilient if AI investment growth slows.

#### Sell Triggers

- if AI capex growth slows sharply
- if energy and permitting bottlenecks curb data-centre buildout

> *"Vi har valt att äga lite mer spadar och hackor i till exempel Nvidia, TCMC, ASML."*

---

### 🟢 TSM — TSMC | **BUY** (Moderate)

**Sentiment**: Positive | **Time Horizon**: LT  
**Confidence**: 60%

Owned as a 'picks and shovels' AI infrastructure holding instead of memory makers.

#### Reasoning

The fund prefers broad AI infrastructure suppliers over volatile memory makers and lists TSMC among its picks-and-shovels holdings.

#### Sell Triggers

- if AI infrastructure investment slows materially

> *"Vi har valt att äga lite mer spadar och hackor i till exempel Nvidia, TCMC, ASML."*

---

### 🟢 ASML — ASML | **BUY** (Moderate)

**Sentiment**: Positive | **Time Horizon**: LT  
**Confidence**: 60%

Owned as a 'picks and shovels' AI infrastructure holding.

#### Reasoning

Part of the fund's shift towards broad AI equipment and infrastructure suppliers rather than memory makers, which it sees as cyclical.

#### Sell Triggers

- if semiconductor capex cycle turns down

> *"Vi har valt att äga lite mer spadar och hackor i till exempel Nvidia, TCMC, ASML."*

---

### 🟢 LITE — Lumentum | **BUY** (Moderate)

**Sentiment**: Positive | **Time Horizon**: MT  
**Confidence**: 60%

The fund recently added to this data-centre optics company (transcribed as 'Elementum').

#### Reasoning

Recently bought as part of a focus on AI-exposed companies that have been more beaten down. These should trade at a more defensive valuation if AI investment growth slows.

#### Sell Triggers

- if data-centre buildout slows sharply

> *"Sen har vi senaste tiden köpt lite mer i ett bolag som heter Elementum som har optik till exempel i datacentra."*
